jobs.description:
**THE OPPORTUNITY

**Are you a newly graduated legal professional or do you have a few years of experience and want to develop your career in a dynamic business? We are looking for a Junior Legal Counsel to join our Legal Team and support the business across key areas such as GDPR, marketing law and consumer law.

You will work closely with colleagues across the organisation, providing legal guidance and finding practical solutions that balance legal requirements with commercial priorities. This is an opportunity to build your legal expertise while gaining an understanding of how legal considerations translate into business decisions.

We are a small, collaborative team where everyone contributes, takes responsibility and gets involved. We value curiosity, initiative and a solution-oriented mindset, giving you room to grow and make an impact.

**What You Will Do

**In this role, you will support different departments across Boozt with a range of legal matters. Your responsibilities will include:

• 
Advise and Support: Provide legal guidance to colleagues across the business, primarily within GDPR, marketing law and consumer law.

• 
Assess and Navigate: Identify legal risks and help the business find practical solutions, balancing legal requirements with commercial needs.

• 
Stay Informed: Keep up to date with relevant laws and regulations to support compliance and minimise risk.

• 
Dispute Resolution: Support the handling and resolution of legal disputes.

**YOUR PROFILE

**You are a curious and pragmatic legal professional who enjoys understanding both the details of a legal matter and the wider business context. You are comfortable taking responsibility, working collaboratively and finding solutions when faced with new challenges.

**About

**You understand that good legal advice is not only about identifying risks, but also about helping the business move forward in a responsible and commercially sound way. We imagine that you have:

• 
A Master's degree in Law from a recognised university.

• 
Recently graduated or have a couple of years of relevant experience, preferably from a law firm or an in-house legal function.

• 
An interest in GDPR, marketing law and consumer law.

• 
Ideally, some exposure to retail, e-commerce or other consumer-facing businesses.

• 
Strong analytical skills and an eye for detail, combined with a pragmatic and solution-oriented mindset.

• 
The ability to communicate legal matters clearly and collaborate with different stakeholders.

• 
Fluency in English and a Scandinavian language.

Last but not least, you are a team player who takes initiative, gets involved and approaches challenges with a "there is always a solution" mindset. You do not need to know everything from day one - curiosity, sound judgement and a willingness to learn matter most.

**WHY BOOZT

**At Boozt, you will become part of an organisation where things move fast and new challenges are part of everyday life. You will join a collaborative team where your input matters, and where you will have the opportunity to grow your legal expertise while gaining insight into different parts of the business.

We believe in Trust, Freedom and Responsibility, and give our colleagues the space to take initiative, make decisions and make their mark. At Boozt, you will be encouraged to ask questions, challenge perspectives and find solutions together.

**Apply today – we’re excited to learn more about you!

**_Only applications submitted in English will be considered.

_Important: Applicants must have the legal right to work in Denmark at the time of employment. Please note that this position does not include visa sponsorship or relocation support.

We review applications on an ongoing basis. You can read more about the process under **Recruitment.

****BOOZT PERKS

**

• 
Great personal and internal career development opportunities

• 
A culture built on our values of trust, freedom, and responsibility

• 
Driven and passionate international colleagues

• 
A generous employee discount

• 
Healthy and delicious breakfast and lunch, top-quality coffee, and fresh fruit available all day

• 
In-house gym, onsite masseuse, and medical doctor

• 
An amazing HQ in central Copenhagen – the iconic, energy-efficient Krystallen building, recognized for its architectural design and sustainability. Enjoy breathtaking city views and much more!

Ready to bridge innovation and operations in one of the Nordics' most recognized media brands?

Egmont IT is looking for a new Platform Engineer profile who thrives on improving and automating our cloud environments, while understanding the importance of stability, governance, and performance.

You’ll join Egmont’s Cloud Platform team, working primarily with Azure, AWS. Egmont’s cloud footprint is very large and requires that everyone thinks about automation and scalability first.

**Your Role & Impact

**We are looking for a colleague that is great at asking questions and challenging decisions. We already have a solid Kubernetes based platform used across the Enterprise. Now we need someone to come and help expand it, help our colleagues using and help in the other areas of Egmonts platform engineering

You will be doing hands-on work on our cloud platforms and solutions to ensure that we constantly improve on new solutions. As well  as evaluating old implementations to determine when it is time to modernize.

Responsibilities

- Operate, develop and build on our Kubernetes platform

- Automating daily work around the cloud platforms we manage

- Develop and maintain tooling (GitHub Actions, Helm, Policies, etc)

- Strengthen observability and proactive monitoring – We use Datadog

- Use Infrastructure as Code to manage changes and enforce standards

- Collaborate with developers, security, and infrastructure teams and business stakeholders to ensure stability and compliance

• Contribute ideas, challenge the status quo, and help evolve our culture

**What You’ll Bring (Qualifications)

**We're looking for a blend of technical expertise and a collaborative, proactive mindset.

**Desired Skills

**- Experience from previous platform engineering or DevOps roles

- Strong hands-on experience with Azure or AWS (Either is fine)

- Scripting or programming skills in any popular language, we use Go

- Experience with IaC tools, any apply, but we use Terraform

- Experience using ArgoCD

- Experience in agentic tooling and a curiosity in following latest trends

- Previously worked with open source and CNCF projects

Personal Qualities

You can build, automate, and optimize, but you also know that reliability, performance, and security are the foundation of success. You’re curious, pragmatic, and want to be part of a team that’s building a hosting platform, which is easy to use for our developers.

It is a requirement for employment that you hold a valid residence and work permit for Denmark.

**Why Egmont?

**At Egmont IT, we enable creativity, not just for artist but also in tech. Behind every story, movie, game, or digital experience lies a foundation of stable and secure technology — and that’s where we come in.

Egmont is a foundation, meaning all our profits are reinvested into developing our media companies and donated to support vulnerable children and young people.

You’ll join an international IT organization with a strong purpose and culture. We believe in flexibility, trust, and development. You’ll have freedom to influence our cloud journey, collaborate with talented colleagues across the Nordics and Europe, and grow through certifications and learning opportunities. A key role in a cloud-driven operations team. A workplace that encourages innovation, collaboration, and autonomy. Flexible hybrid work setup (Copenhagen HQ + home office). A chance to make a real difference — We bring stories to life

Ready to join?

**Logistics & How to Apply

**Location: Vognmagergade 11, 1148 Copenhagen K, Denmark

Application deadline: December 18 , 2026

Interviews: Will be scheduled periodically.

Please send your application as soon as possible - we review applications continuously. Applications are welcome in both Danish and English. To apply, please use the "Apply Now" button on this page. Please note that we do not accept applications via email.

If you have any questions about the role, feel free to contact Rasmus Jørgensen (Manager, Cloud Platforms) at rasmusbo.jorgensen@egmont.com.

We look forward to hearing from you!

About Egmont

Egmont is a leading Nordic media group focused on strong content and platforms within film, tv, cinema, streaming, gaming, e-commerce, marketing services, educational platforms, magazines and books. Proud owner of strong companies like Nordisk Film, TV 2 in Norway, Lindhardt og Ringhof and Story House Egmont. Being a foundation, all profit is reinvested in our media companies and donated to help improve the lives of vulnerable children and young people and support film talents.

We bring stories to life.

- for the developer who wants to build real things with AI

You write clean code, you have started integrating LLMs into real projects, and you are curious about what comes next. In Egmont's Data & AI Solutions team, you will build practical AI solutions - APIs, LLM wrappers, MCP connectors - that business teams across the Nordics depend on, while sharing ownership of the production systems that keep everything running. Hands-on from day one, with room to grow.

The role

You will be joining a team that builds and maintains AI and data solutions for business units across the Egmont Group - tools and integrations that people actually use.

Your work will cover three areas:

Build applied AI solutions. On top of Egmont’s AI platform infrastructure, you will build LLM wrappers, APIs, and MCP connectors - and take prototypes from concept to working solutions for business units with AI-related challenges.

Support Egmont's companies. You will work directly with companies across the Egmont Group, as both a hands-on builder and an advisor. That means helping business teams see where AI can make a real difference, shaping the right approach with them, and staying involved until it works in practice.

Keep things running - and make them better. You will share ownership of our Prefect-orchestrated Python pipelines alongside our senior engineers, handling operational triage, debugging, and continuous stability improvements.

What you bring

We care more about what you have built and how you think than about your job titles. That said, to hit the ground running, you will bring at least two years of experience in software development or a similar field, along with most of the following:

- Solid Python development experience - clean, modular code and confidence building and consuming APIs, including authentication, JSON and error handling

- Practical LLM integration experience - you have worked with language models in real settings and know your way around context engineering, MCP and agentic integrations

- An analytical and operational mindset - you keep the bigger picture in view, spot problems before they become incidents and take pride in systems that stay stable

Bonus points for experience with orchestration tools, lightweight frontends or Azure and AWS basics.

Beyond the technical, we are looking for someone curious and clear in their communication, who enjoys making technology accessible to non-technical colleagues. Knowledge of a Scandinavian language is an advantage, as Egmont is primarily a Nordic media group.

The team

You will be joining Data & AI Solutions - a tight-knit team of developers. We work closely with the platform team that runs the data and AI infrastructure our solutions are built on, so you will always have strong technical peers to spar with.

The role is based at Egmont's corporate office in Copenhagen. A flexible hybrid setup is possible, and we can agree on the balance between office and home days together.

And yes - the canteen is excellent.

**Logistics & How to Apply

**- Location: Copenhagen (hybrid possible)

- Application deadline: December 6, 2026

- Employment type: Full-time, permanent

To apply, please use the "Apply Now" button on this page. Note that we do not accept applications via email. Applications are welcome in Danish, Norwegian, Swedish or English.

We review applications continuously, so please apply as soon as possible.

If you have questions about the role, you are welcome to reach out to Hampus Vitestam, Manager Data & AI Solutions at hampus.vitestam@egmont.com.

About Egmont

Egmont is a leading Nordic media group focused on strong content and platforms within film, tv, cinema, streaming, gaming, e-commerce, marketing services, educational platforms, magazines and books. Proud owner of strong companies like Nordisk Film, TV 2 in Norway, Lindhardt og Ringhof and Story House Egmont. Being a foundation, all profit is reinvested in our media companies and donated to help improve the lives of vulnerable children and young people and support film talents.

We bring stories to life.

**The Impact You'll Make

**Join the Danfoss Technology Centre, a team of materials and process specialists supporting Danfoss businesses worldwide.

From our advanced laboratories in Nordborg, Denmark, we provide expert advice, testing, analysis, and consultancy. We help solve complex technical challenges, support product development, and improve product and process performance.

As our new Senior Specialist, you will provide advanced materials science expertise, primarily within metals and other inorganic materials. You will lead complex materials and failure investigations, turn analytical results into clear conclusions, and advise colleagues and stakeholders on practical solutions.

Your expertise will help teams across Danfoss make well-informed technical decisions and develop reliable, high-performing products and processes.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Lead complex materials and failure investigations, including fracture, contamination, and microstructural analysis.

• Analyze metals and other inorganic materials using scanning electron microscopy and energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (SEM/EDX).

• Turn scientific findings into clear conclusions, reports, presentations, and practical recommendations.

• Coordinate customer assignments involving many stakeholders, samples, and analytical methods.

• Improve analytical methods, assure quality, and share knowledge with specialists and laboratory technicians.

You will also use scientific literature to support investigations and keep our materials knowledge and methods up to date.

**What We're Looking For

**To succeed in this role, you bring:

• Strong materials characterization expertise, including hands-on SEM/EDX and failure analysis experience.

• A PhD in materials science, metallurgy, or a related field is preferred.

• The ability to independently lead complex technical investigations from problem definition to recommendation.

• Strong scientific problem-solving skills and a practical approach to laboratory work.

• Clear English communication skills and the ability to communicate and engage stakeholders at all levels.

Experience from an industrial environment or technical consultancy is highly desirable. You are also curious, collaborative, and able to turn scientific knowledge into practical engineering solutions.

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• Work with advanced laboratories and varied technical challenges across Danfoss.

• Collaborate with specialists, technicians, and product developers worldwide.

• Help engineer a better future through solutions that make a global difference.

• Grow through mentoring, learning opportunities, and global career paths.

• Enjoy flexibility, autonomy, and support for a healthy work-life balance.

• Join an inclusive workplace where everyone is respected and empowered.

• Receive competitive benefits, including bonus, vacation, pension, and health insurance. Benefits vary by country and contract.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If you are motivated by solving complex materials challenges and using your expertise to create practical value, we would like to hear from you.

Please apply through our online recruitment system. We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every preferred qualification. Your experience may bring perspectives and strengths that will add value to our team.

**For Further Information About The Position, Please Contact

**Dorthe Berg Buciek, Senior Manager,

Email: **buciek@danfoss.com

**Phone: **+45 29 48 70 19

****Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

Do you want to be a valued part of the critical infrastructure that serves communities across Europe and beyond? Are you looking for a position in which you can set direction and help shape our company? If so, then you could be the newest addition to our team as Finance Business Partner.

**Be part of the movement – and play your part

****About The Role

**DFDS operates through two divisions – Logistics and Ferry. In this role, you will join the central Business Finance team for the Logistics Division and take part in how financial performance is measured, steered, and improved across a rapidly growing European logistics business. You will report to the Head of Central Business Finance Logistics, who reports to the Divisional CFO Logistics.

The central Business Finance team holds ownership of all core financial planning, reporting, functional finance, and commercial support activities of the Logistics Division. You will join a team of four Finance Business Partners in Copenhagen and two Business Analysts in our Shared Service Center in Poznan.

**Within The Team, You Will Take Responsibilities In

**

• Driving the divisional monthly- and quarterly performance cycle, incl. reporting and budgeting

• Driving improvement initiatives for the reporting framework, automation and data quality

• Engaging in improvement initiatives in the data models, and planning frameworks relevant to the performance cycle

• Supporting the adoption of new KPI frameworks and models for risk assessment to the performance outlook

• Supporting financial insight and decision material to senior stakeholders in central functions

• Financial processes, data models and analytical tooling incl. usage of EPM, BI and AI tools

Further, you will work closely with the Group FP&A team and the Senior Finance Business Partners across business units to ensure aligned financial processes, shared standards, and timely reporting.

Your role will be hands on, performing reporting- and analytical activities, together with a team that sits at the centre of the division’s performance agenda.

You will be based at our headquarters in Copenhagen and join a driven and dedicated Business Finance team where colleagues work closely together, support each other, and take pride in driving clarity and impact for the business. The division has more than tripled in size in recent years, and the business finance function is at the core of driving performance in this setting.

**About You

**You thrive in a role that combines the recurrent periodic reporting activities with hands-on analytical work, contributing to the strategic direction for the division. With this in mind, we imagine that the ideal candidate brings:

• +2 years of experience within FP&A or Business Finance, preferably from large, international, or complex organisations

• Understanding of financial processes, planning cycles, P&L, balance sheet and cash flow

• Strong analytical skills and structured problem solving abilities

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

• A collaborative mindset and strong personal drive

• Fundamental understanding of EPM or ERP systems (e.g., OneStream/HFM, D365/SAP/Oracle or similar)

• Experience with and/or interest in leveraging AI to improve reporting, analysis, and ways of working

• Experience in the logistics sector and project management is a plus, but not required

A degree in finance, economics, business administration, or similar is expected. Full professional proficiency in English is required.

We think the strongest teams are built on diversity and inclusivity. Contrasting opinions, varied skills, and strong characters bring out the best in us all. And we cannot wait for you to join.

**Working at DFDS

****Join the movement and grow with us

**As part of the Logistics Division - a business that has tripled in size over recent years - you will be at the heart of major strategic transformation as the division works to develop its network and digitise a traditionally manual industry.

While you’re with us, we want you to develop. At DFDS, development happens first and foremost through real work. We will also offer training and support when needed.

We promote a great workplace with a diverse and vibrant community. At our Copenhagen headquarters, we enjoy a modern workspace with award-winning facilities, different work zones, own game room, fitness facilities, canteen and a café with a rooftop terrace with a beautiful ocean view, all just 5 minutes from the nearest train & metro station.

**Are we a match? Then what are you waiting for? Apply now.

**If you think your personality, skills, and experience match this role, we’d love to hear from you. Please send us your CV as soon as possible, as we’re keen to meet candidates on an ongoing basis.

If you have questions about the role, you are welcome to contact Jens Beck, Head of Logistics Finance Business Partnering, Central, at jenbeck@dfds.com.

**We look forward to hearing from you.

**This recruitment process is managed by the DFDS Talent Acquisition team. We kindly ask external recruitment agencies to refrain from contacting us regarding this opportunity.

jobs.occupation: Norwegian speaking - Looking for a Job in Aarhus?
jobs.description:
Aalund are market leaders when it comes to B2B research and that is why we are looking for ambitious B2B researchers. The task is to conduct telephone interviews with Norwegean business managers and other decisionmakers.

As a B2B researcher at Aalund, it is your task to make sure that our respondents are given a unique experience. New projects are continuously added to our pipeline to the benefit of your professional development. We offer one of the most attractive salary arrangements in the business as well as an ambitious environment with an informal work culture.

At Aalund, professionalism, experience and humour are part of our culture. We offer a 36 hour work week, and working hours are weekdays between 8.30 AM and 4 PM although on Fridays we finish at 2:30 PM.

On top of that, we offer: 

·        Training in communication and interview technique while we also teach you our interviewing philosophy

·        Project briefings and a close interaction with our supervisors and consultants

·        Relevant experience that you can use onwards in your career

·        A dynamic team which includes full time and part time employees

·        Opportunity to take part in a mentoring project

·        A job that will look good on your resume

·        Involvement in projects relevant to your studies

·        Salary: 140-160 DKK/hour once you have passed our basic course, and opportunity to become Executive Researcher with higher salary and more experience

·        Social events every quarter

 

Does that sound attractive to you? Send an application which includes your resume to our job portal https://job.aalund.com/ and you will soon hear from us.

**Job Requisition ID #

**26WD102106

**Locations where we are Hiring

**This is not a current open position. Soon, we will be investing in remote Regional Field Sales roles across the EMEA region specific to Europe: Ireland, Denmark, Sweden, United Kingdom, France, Germany, Netherlands, and Spain.

**Our Story

**The world’s innovators, designers, engineers, builders and creators trust Autodesk to help them design and make a better world for all.

Autodesk’s Design and Make Platform empowers customers to transform how they work through cloud-connected technology, automation, AI, data and insights. From the buildings and infrastructure around us to the products we use and the entertainment that inspires us, Autodesk technology helps our customers design and make the world around us.

Our customers are navigating significant change, including sustainability pressures, labor and supply-chain challenges, rapid technological advancement and increasing digital complexity. Global Expansion Sales helps them unlock greater value from Autodesk by uncovering new opportunities, expanding adoption and connecting Autodesk solutions to their most important business priorities.

**Position Overview

****As an Account Executive in Global Expansion Sales, you will lead Autodesk’s growth strategy across a focused portfolio of assigned customers.

**You will operate as a senior business partner to the customer, bringing a hunter mindset to existing relationships: creating new demand, uncovering substantial whitespace, opening new buying centers and expanding Autodesk into strategic workflows, business units and transformation initiatives.

You will be expected to lead complex, high-value enterprise sales cycles, including seven-figure opportunities and multi-year commercial agreements, while orchestrating the broader Autodesk ecosystem around a common customer strategy. Success will be measured through sustained expansion growth, material pipeline creation, increased share of wallet, executive sponsorship, customer outcomes and forecast accuracy.

**Responsibilities

**

• Own and lead the multi-year growth and expansion strategy for assigned customers.

• Develop deep knowledge of each customer’s business model, strategic objectives, operating environment, industry dynamics and transformation agenda.

• Establish a clear point of view on where Autodesk can create differentiated business value for the customer.

• Identify significant whitespace across business units, geographies, workflows, technology estates, user communities and executive priorities.

• Create demand and originate large strategic opportunities, including seven-figure deals and opportunities that may not yet exist in the customer’s formal buying process.

• Build relationships across new buying centers while deepening trusted relationships with existing stakeholders.

• Develop C-suite and senior executive sponsorship across business and technology functions.

• Bring external market, industry and customer insight into executive conversations, with relevant knowledge of Autodesk’s Design and Make industries.

• Translate customer strategy into compelling multi-year value propositions, transformation roadmaps and business cases.

• Lead complex, high-value and potentially multi-year sales cycles involving multiple business, technical, procurement, finance and legal stakeholders.

• Develop and execute competitive strategies to win strategically significant new workloads and displace incumbent technologies.

• Navigate sophisticated commercial arrangements and seven-figure negotiations with strong business and financial acumen.

• Mobilize Autodesk’s executive leadership and broader organization around a unified account strategy.

• Orchestrate Technical Sales, Customer Success, Industry, Partners, Marketing, Professional Services and other specialists at the appropriate stages of the customer journey.

• Develop strategic ecosystem and partner relationships that increase Autodesk’s impact and relevance.

• Maintain executive-level governance around opportunities, risks, dependencies and account priorities.

• Apply account-planning, relationship-mapping, customer intelligence, forecasting and AI-enabled tools responsibly to support multi-year account strategy, executive engagement and opportunity governance.

• Maintain rigorous pipeline quality and deliver accurate, evidence-based forecasts.

• Represent the voice of the customer within Autodesk while bringing relevant Autodesk innovation, capability and thought leadership back to the customer.

**What Success Looks Like

**Sustained strategic revenue growth; creation and conversion of substantial new whitespace; increased Autodesk share of wallet; expansion into strategically important workloads and business initiatives; deep C-suite sponsorship; successful execution of seven-figure opportunities; strong multi-year account strategies; competitive displacement; measurable customer outcomes; and consistently high-quality forecasting.

**Minimum Qualifications

**

• Demonstrated success leading complex enterprise technology, SaaS, cloud or strategic software sales.

• Proven record of creating and closing significant opportunities within large, complex customer organizations, including experience with seven-figure deals or comparable commercial complexity.

• Demonstrated ability to create demand and develop major opportunities rather than simply manage an existing pipeline.[KS1]

• Strong C-suite presence with the ability to engage credibly on business, industry and transformation priorities.

• Exceptional strategic account-planning and whitespace-development capability.

• Strong business and financial acumen and ability to build compelling economic and strategic business cases.

• Experience leading sophisticated multi-stakeholder and multi-year sales processes.

• Strong competitive selling, negotiation and commercial leadership capability.

• Demonstrated ability to lead large virtual teams and influence senior stakeholders without direct authority.

• Exceptional communication, storytelling and executive presentation skills.

• High standards of commercial judgment, accountability, pipeline management and forecasting.

• Demonstrated fluency with CRM, strategic account-planning, relationship-mapping, pipeline and forecasting platforms. Experience with Salesforce, Clari, Altify or comparable platforms is valued.

**Preferred Qualifications

**

• Deep knowledge of a relevant Autodesk Solution Group industry - AEC, Manufacturing or Media & Entertainment - where appropriate to the assigned customer portfolio.

• Experience selling enterprise platforms, cloud technology or large-scale transformation solutions.

• Experience navigating complex multinational customer organizations.

• Demonstrated success developing multi-year executive relationships and transformation programs.

• Track record of strategic competitive displacement and significant share-of-wallet growth.

**How We Work At Autodesk

**At Autodesk, we work as One Autodesk and bring our One ORBIT values to life every day: Optimistic, Relentless, Brave, Ingenious and Trusted.

In this role, you will bring those values to life by leading as One Autodesk, bringing a bold and informed point of view to our customers, making smart decisions in complex environments, creating new possibilities and earning long-term trust at the highest levels of the customer organization.

****Learn More

******About Autodesk

**Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

**Salary transparency

**Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. For Germany based roles, we expect a starting base salary between 122,850 EUR and 180,180 EUR Annual. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location, and may exceed this range. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.

**Belonging

We seek an experienced, highly motivated, and independent laboratory technician to support the Novo Nordisk Foundation Center for Protein Design (CPD) at the University of Copenhagen (UCPH). This is a full-time position, starting as soon as possible, and employment through 31 July 2032.

  Our research:

  The CPD is a multidisciplinary centre that works across the university—notably with the Departments of Biology, Drug Design and Pharmacology, Chemistry, and Computer Science—and with national and international academic and industrial partners. CPD is funded by an initial grant of 700M DKK for seven years from the Novo Nordisk Foundation. At capacity, the CPD is expected to have ≈8 research groups, ≈80 researchers, and support staff. Research will encompass the growing protein design landscape with computational, experimental, applied and hybrid projects.

  The CPD's vision and mission are to accelerate protein design by deepening understanding of sequence-to-structure/function relationships in proteins, and to train the next generation of protein scientists to apply protein-design approaches and methods to a diverse array of fundamental and real-world challenges.  

  CPD research is broadly organised into three themes: Programmable De Novo Protein Design, aimed at improving methods for protein design by combining rational, physics-based and AI-based approaches; Contextualised Protein Design, which is about designing proteins that are fit for purpose, such as working directly and optimally in cells, chemical reactors, etc.; and Biodesign for Sustainability and Healthcare, for instance working with biotech and industry to deliver synthetic proteins to address grand challenges in these areas.

  Further information on the CPD see: cpd.ku.dk.

  Your job:

  Specifically, we seek a talented laboratory technician and team player to help set up, equip and support research in newly refurbished labs. You will join the CPD Operations and Management Team, work closely with another laboratory technician and the CPD Experimental Officer, and fulfil a key role supporting CPD researchers.

  Tasks of the Laboratory Technician will include:

   	
• Assist in setting up, establishing, and organising newly refurbished CPD laboratories together with a laboratory technician and the CPD Experimental Officer. 	
• Order, track, and manage laboratory supplies, consumables, and chemical inventory, including invoice processing. 	
• Solicit and evaluate quotes from multiple vendors for large equipment purchases in accordance with university and public procurement guidelines. 	
• Process purchase orders, verify deliveries, monitor invoices, and register new equipment. 	
• Serve as a key contributor to safety compliance, chemical registration, and risk assessment coordination. 	
• Drive and maintain environmental sustainability initiatives in KU, targeting LEAF (Laboratory Efficiency Assessment Framework) 	
• Establish and maintain rigorous safety routines, waste management and documentation. 	
• Contribute to onboarding new researchers, visiting scientists, and students, including safety introductions, lab space allocation, and workflow introductions. 	
• Contribute to the offboarding processes by ensuring proper handover of samples and data and chemical/waste disposal. 	
• Prepare shared stock solutions and reagents 	
• Contribute to practical laboratory classes and guide new researchers on standard operating procedures.   Profile:

  To succeed in this role, we anticipate that you have a lab technician (laborant) degree or similar. We also expect you to be a service-minded team player who likes managing the day-to-day operation of a laboratory, including carrying out administrative tasks like obtaining quotations and handling purchasing and procurement activities.

  Preferably, you have experience with hands-on expertise in solid-phase peptide synthesis and peptide purification, solid knowledge of biochemistry laboratory safety regulations, and a keen interest in collaborating with researchers from different backgrounds. You should bring a strong motivation for optimising lab organisation and safety, alongside a genuine interest in teaching students and guiding new researchers within a dynamic, international academic environment.

  Essential experience and skills

   	
• Highly structured, detail-oriented, and able to prioritise and execute tasks independently 	
• Knowledge of biochemical and/or chemical research and teaching laboratories 	
• Understanding of Good Laboratory Practice, chemical and biological safety regulations, standard documentation practices, and inventory management 	
• Strong and proven organisational, communication, and networking skills 	
• Good written and spoken Danish and English language skills   Desirable experience and skills

   	
• Experience with solid-phase peptide synthesis (SPPS) and peptide purification 	
• Experience with Kemibrug, SDI and RejsUd 	
• Experience with the LEAF or similar green laboratory sustainability programmes 	
• Perform routine recombinant protein expression and purification to generate shared stocks 	
• Experience with mammalian cell lines and preparing bacterial competent cells   Place of employment

  The place of employment is at the NNF Center for Protein Design, located at the Department of Drug Design and Pharmacology, University of Copenhagen. We offer creative, stimulating working conditions in a dynamic, international research environment.

  Terms of salary and employment
 The employment as a laboratory technician (TAP) is a full-time (37 hours/week) position with employment through 31 July 2032. The starting date is as soon as possible, and, ideally, the successful candidate will be in place by March 2027 to coincide with the preparations for opening newly refurbished labs.

  Employment will be in accordance with the provisions of the collective agreement between the Danish Ministry of Finance and HK Stat, Organisationsaftalen for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og it-medarbejdere. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector on this page Lønoverblik

  The monthly salary will be based on of work experience, with the possibility to negotiate a salary supplement based on prior experience and qualifications.

  Questions
 For further information regarding the position, please contact CPD Experimental Officer, Ana Almeida, ana.almeida@sund.ku.dk.

  Learn more about the Department of Drug Design and Pharmacology, https://drug.ku.dk/, and Center for Protein Design https://cpd.ku.dk/

  Application
 Your application should be in English and include:

   	
• A cover letter outlining your fit to the role and motivation for applying (max. one page) 	
• Curriculum Vitae (incl. the names of two references (max. two pages)  	
• A certified/signed copy of certificate(s) of education   Please submit your application by clicking on “Apply Now” below. Only online applications will be accepted.

  Application deadline: 4 January 2027, 23:59 [CET]

  We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications that do not meet the above requirements.

  Interviews are expected to be held in January 2027.

  The University of Copenhagen wishes to reflect the diversity of society and welcomes applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of age, disability, gender, nationality, race, religion, or sexual orientation. Appointment will be based on merit alone.

  As part of the International Alliance of Research Universities (IARU) and among Europe’s top-ranking universities, the University of Copenhagen promotes research and teaching to the highest international standard. Rich in tradition and modern in outlook, the University gives students and staff the opportunity to cultivate their talent in an ambitious and informal environment. An effective organisation – with good working conditions and a collaborative work culture – creates the ideal framework for a successful academic career.

aye aye – part of Admiral Hotel

aye aye is Admiral Hotel’s restaurant – a modern interpretation of classic gastronomy with a focus on flavor, precision, and craftsmanship. Who you are

As our new Souschef, you will become a key part of a well-established kitchen management team. You will report directly to the Head Chef and have significant influence on our menus, work structures, and the daily working environment.

You will work across the entire culinary operation – from our restaurant aye aye and the terrace to room service and large banquets.

You’ll be a great fit if you:

• 
Are a trained chef with at least 5 years of experience in a similar role.

• 
Are structured and quick to act in situations that require immediate solutions. In other words—you can plan, stay organized, and ensure the kitchen is always ready for service.

• 
Have strong communication skills, ensuring handovers, orders, and teamwork are always clear and precise.

• 
Understand and agree that a good working environment is the foundation for great food.

• 
Take professional pride in your work—you care about quality, craftsmanship, and attention to detail in every dish.

• 
Master classical techniques and are confident with sauces, stocks, pasta, fish and meat butchery, bread baking, as well as ice cream and dessert preparation.
